## Instructions for Form 706, United States Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return

Internal Revenue Service · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i706>

Machine-readable: <https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-4768>

**Authoritative for:** Who must file, the nine-month due date and the Form 4768 extension, and the portability election and its timing — the reason a 706 is filed when no tax is due.

## New Jersey Division of Taxation — Inheritance and Estate Tax

New Jersey Division of Taxation · NJ · **read and cite only — copyrighted, do not reproduce**

<https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/inheritance-estate/inheritance.shtml>

**Authoritative for:** The Division's statement of the transfer inheritance tax, resident and non-resident, and the end of the New Jersey estate tax for deaths on or after January 1, 2018, with links to its guides, the compromise-tax guide and the actuarial tables.

## New Jersey Statutes — current text

New Jersey Legislature, Office of Legislative Services · NJ · public domain — quote freely

<https://lis.njleg.state.nj.us/nxt/gateway.dll?f=templates&fn=default.htm>

Machine-readable: <https://pub.njleg.state.nj.us/statutes/>

**Authoritative for:** The current text of every New Jersey statute cited here — Title 3B (wills, probate, intestacy, fiduciary commissions, refunding bonds, the Uniform Trust Code), Title 46 (powers of attorney, the realty transfer fee and the Graduated Percent Fee), Title 26 (advance directives), Title 54 (the transfer inheritance tax and the bulk sale notice) and Title 52 (remote notarial acts). Read the section; a summary on a firm's website is not the law.
